title: Interior Material Quality and Trim
summary: Feedback on the G70 interior materials is split between praise for perceived quality and complaints about specific trim, mats, and surfaces that feel undesirable or show wear easily.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the interior materials as high quality, especially the overall cabin feel and seat materials.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the mats and center-console materials and report piano black surfaces that show dust, fingerprints, or scuffing easily.

mixed.summary: The mixed review praises neither side clearly and instead reports seat material that soils or scuffs easily on a white perforated interior.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention material quality or desired material changes without enough context to confirm clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 owners.
One positive example appears to describe a requested seat material upgrade, which limits confidence in how clearly it reflects satisfaction.
Undetermined fragments are brief or incomplete, limiting detail about the exact material issue or praise.
